title: 第五章 水枪水枪还是水枪第六章 过度章
content_zh:
尼比市，林萧望着城市中的大楼感慨无限，一个星期的时间林萧都在常磐森林里乱串，直到今天所有的食材消耗完毕才依依不舍的离开，对于可以不停刷金币的地方，林萧很是不舍，但是没办法旅行仍需继续，吃的也消耗殆尽，不得不离开。
虽然森林里的一些果实可以吃，而且很多训练家都干这样的事情，吃果实。
这个世界的水果，绝大部分的品种林萧都会进而远之。
林萧是个挑嘴的家伙，一手大厨级别的手艺也是因为那张贪吃的嘴练出来的，不论什么食材林萧都能做出一些口味可佳的菜，不过海鲜例外。
贪吃的林萧忍受不得腥味，海鲜这玩意是吃一次吐一次。不仅如此，就连平时一些排骨，鸡汤之类的玩意，只要腥味处理不好也绝对不碰，恰恰这个世界的各种野生果实都带的有一股淡淡的生鸡蛋味道。
对于其他人来说可能问题不大，但是对于林萧来说那就像吃海鲜，在大木研究所吃过一次后，就坚决于这玩意绝缘。
其实林萧离开常磐森林确实是正确的选择，因为和野生小精灵战斗只有第一次战斗才有金币拿，要是林萧真抱着无限刷金币的想法注定会很失望。
在神奇宝贝中恢复杰尼龟和快龙的体力，随后一人二宠在餐厅饱餐一顿，这才优哉优哉的朝道馆走去。
“不知道尼比道馆的训练家是小刚还是他老汉武能，我在常磐森林里耽误了一个礼拜的时间，小智和小刚应该离开了吧。”
推开道馆的大门，林萧四处打探，虽然有点黑，阴沉沉的但也没有那么恐怖啊，还是小孩子的心理做鬼，大部分刚出来旅行的小屁孩挑战尼比道馆都会被吓一跳。
“有人在吗，我是来挑战道馆的训练家。”
“拍！”
道馆里的灯全都亮了起来，一个15.6岁，留着刺猬头，皮肤黑黑的男孩坐在一块石头上。
想必这应该是小刚吧，不过这造型确实有点戳，本来人就黑，还是咪，咪眼，更蛋疼的是那灰色裤子和灰色马甲，难怪没有女人看上他，就这衰样是个女人都害怕。。。。。。
小刚的样子让林萧想起一句，黑熊挖煤炭，屁，眼心太黑，结果越挖越黑。同时也为小智感到悲哀，这你妹的都一个礼拜了，那白痴居然还没有走出常磐森林，那得多高的智商才能达到这程度。。。。。
“道馆挑战的规则是2v2，期间馆主不能更换小精灵，直到一方的小精灵全部倒下。”
林萧微微点头示意自己明白，掏出杰尼龟的宝贝球道：“杰尼龟，第一场战斗就由你上场了。”
“杰尼，杰尼。”
小家伙对于战斗还是很渴望的，刚出来就高兴的大呼小叫。
“杰尼龟吗？”

小刚若有所思的看了一眼杰尼龟，拿出宝贝球。
“大岩蛇，该你上场了。”
“吼！”
大岩石庞大的身躯出现在场地中，居高临下的瞪着杰尼龟。
面对大岩蛇不善的目光杰尼龟一点胆怯的意思都没有，天天和快龙这种实力超强的神奇宝贝在一起还被大岩蛇吓到的话，那真新不用活了。
先下手为强，后下手遭殃的道理林萧还是懂的，直接喊道：“杰尼龟对准大岩蛇的头部使用水枪。”
“噗！”
在小刚和大岩蛇还没有反应过来，水枪就已经命中了大岩蛇的脑袋，一颗硕大的石头脑袋瞬间变得湿哒哒的。
content_en:
In Nibi City, Lin Xiao looked at the buildings in the city with endless emotion. For a week, Lin Xiao wandered around the Viridian Forest. It was not until today that all the ingredients were consumed before he reluctantly left. Lin Xiao was very reluctant to leave a place where he could keep earning gold coins, but he had no choice but to continue traveling and all the food was exhausted, so he had to leave.
Although some fruits in the forest can be eaten, and many trainers do this and eat the fruits.
Lin Xiao would go far beyond most of the varieties of fruits in this world.
Lin Xiao is a picky guy, and his chef-level skills are also developed because of his greedy mouth. No matter what ingredients are used, Lin Xiao can make some delicious dishes, but seafood is an exception.
The gluttonous Lin Xiao couldn't stand the fishy smell and would vomit every time he ate seafood. Not only that, even the usual pork ribs, chicken soup and other things will never be touched as long as the fishy smell is not handled well. It just so happens that all kinds of wild fruits in this world have a faint smell of raw eggs.
It might not be a big problem for other people, but for Lin Xiao, it was like eating seafood. After eating it once at the Damu Research Institute, he was determined to insulate himself from this thing.
In fact, it was indeed the right choice for Lin Xiao to leave Viridian Forest, because you can only get gold coins in the first battle with wild elves. If Lin Xiao really had the idea of ​​​​grinding unlimited gold coins, he would definitely be disappointed.
After recovering the physical strength of Squirtle and Kuailong in Pokémon, one and two pets had a hearty meal in the restaurant, and then walked towards the gym in a leisurely manner.
"I don't know if the trainer of Nibi Gym is Xiao Gang or his old man Wu Neng. I was wasted in Viridian Forest for a week. Xiaozhi and Xiao Gang should have left."
Pushing open the door of the gym, Lin Xiao looked around. Although it was a bit dark and gloomy, it was not that scary. It was still the psychology of a child, and most of the little kids who had just traveled would be shocked when they challenged Nibi Gym.
"Is anyone here? I'm here to challenge the gym's trainer."
"Shoot!"
All the lights in the gym were on, and a 15.6-year-old boy with spiky hair and dark skin was sitting on a rock.
Presumably this should be Xiaogang, but his appearance is indeed a bit poignant. He is originally dark, and he still has big eyes. What is even more annoying is the gray pants and gray vest. No wonder no woman likes him. He is so bad that even a woman is afraid. . . . . .
Xiaogang's look reminded Lin Xiao of a saying, a black bear digs coal, its eyes are too dark, and the more it digs, the darker it gets. At the same time, I feel sad for Xiaozhi. It's been a week since your sister, and that idiot hasn't left the Viridian Forest yet. How much IQ does it take to reach this level? . . . .
"The rules of the gym challenge are 2v2. During this period, the gym leader cannot change the elves until all the elves on one side fall."
Lin Xiao nodded slightly to indicate that he understood, and took out Squirtle's precious fairway: "Squirtle, you will be on the field for the first battle."
"Jenny, Jenny."
The little guy was still eager to fight, and he shouted with joy as soon as he came out.
"Squirtle?"
Xiaogang glanced at Squirtle thoughtfully and took out the baby ball.
"Big Rock Snake, it's your turn."
"Roar!"
Big Rock's huge body appeared in the field, glaring at Squirtle condescendingly.
Squirtle didn't feel timid at all when facing Big Rock Snake's unkind look. If he was frightened by Big Rock Snake when he was with a super powerful Pokémon like Kuailong every day, then Zhenxin wouldn't have to live.
Lin Xiao still understood the principle of attacking first to gain the upper hand and attacking later to suffer. He directly shouted: "Squirtle aims at the head of the big rock snake and uses the water gun."
"Poof!"
Before Xiaogang and Big Rock Snake could react, the water gun had already hit Big Rock Snake's head, and the huge stone head instantly became wet.
